answers.question: Did the agent stay on the shift offer without inventing other topics as facts?
answers.quote: I appreciate you asking! I only have info about the shift itself, though; for anything else, the office will help after this call. So, would you like to take the wound care shift on Monday from 7:55 pm to 3:55 am in Jersey City at $40 an hour?

answers.question: Did the agent close politely when the nurse had to go?
answers.quote: Thanks for your time and have a great day! If you want to chat or take shifts in the future, just let me know. Take care!
